root_cause: The installed-payload autopkgtest ran ldd on Discover backend plugins as isolated ELF objects. kns-backend.so needs libDiscoverCommon.so but has no private RUNPATH of its own; the host plasma-discover executable both directly needs libDiscoverCommon.so and carries RUNPATH=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/plasma-discover, so the private library is loaded in the real Discover process before its backend plugin is resolved. Isolated ldd therefore produced a false-negative linkage failure even though the library is present in the plasma-discover package and the real Ubuntu-to-SupraLINUX upgrade test passed.
repair_scope: Autopkgtest only. Keep KDE source, compiled runtime payload, Qt, Frameworks and package split unchanged. Make installed-payload assert the private libDiscoverCommon.so payload explicitly, keep normal ldd checks for standalone executables, and evaluate Discover backend plugins with the private Discover library directory in their loader environment to reproduce the host application's plugin context.
reentry: Increment Debian revision to 6.7.5-0supralinux4 because the reviewed test payload changes, mark preflight50 inapplicable only for revision4 packaging/test bytes, add a cheap regression for the plugin loader-context rule, then obtain a fresh authoritative input preflight before Attempt4.
